$comment: Teaching level 4 (overhaul, paced S4): reliquaries and growth. Pray at the Reliquary (it teaches Whirlwind, remembers the Spirit Well and answers three times), build the Spirit Well it remembered, raise six dwellings, then gain 28 followers over the count when that stage opens (fromStage, so growth already made never counts) within twenty five minutes. The well comes before the dwellings so it is a real step, not one already met.
name: The Old Reliquary
description: An old Reliquary stands on the hill. Pray there to learn Whirlwind and to remember the Spirit Well, build the well, raise six dwellings and then grow your tribe by 28 more followers before the season turns.

rewards.text: The Reliquary teaches Whirlwind and your people remember the Spirit Well. It can answer twice more.

objectives.text: Pray at the Reliquary on the hill
Build a Spirit Well (the Reliquary remembered how)
Grow by 28 more followers from here: upgrade dwellings so they hold more and breed on

do.text: Send four followers to pray at the Reliquary. Build dwellings so your tribe grows.
A ward settles over the hill.
Now plan a Spirit Well near the Hearth. It adds mana income.
The well flows. Raise six dwellings so the tribe can grow.
Upgrade your dwellings so they hold more and breed on. The Reliquary prayed again gives more Whirlwinds.
Two dozen followers. Keep breeding up; the winter is long.
Five minutes of the season remain.
